text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] Synthetic probe "apac-east/canary-17" FAILED - 5xx spike (5m avg 18%) — PagerDuty incident P23456 — https://pagerduty.redwood.com/incidents/P23456 — probe_run=2026-03-15T07:45Z

alice.nguyen: acked. i'm oncall, looking into it.

pd-bot: Incident P23456 acknowledged by alice.nguyen

samir.khan: looking. pulling prober logs now.

alice.nguyen: quick check — is this isolated to apac-east?

maria.patel: seeing increased 502s from the prober -> upstream runtime nodes. grafana shows gateway 502s coming from runtime-rt-12 around 07:43-07:46.

samir.khan: logs peek: ```2026-03-15T07:44:32Z prober.go:421 request failed status=502 upstream=runtime-rt-12 region=apac-east err="downstream reset"``` also saw OOM kills for runtime-rt-12 at 07:42 and 07:44.

alice.nguyen: `curl -v https://prober-apac-east.internal/health` -> ```HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"uptime":"72h"}``` prober itself healthy. looks upstream.

samir.khan: kubectl output: ```kubectl get pods -n runtime | grep runtime-rt-12
runtime-rt-12-aaa   0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   3   5m``` restarts=3, recent OOMKilled in container status.

maria.patel: metrics: model-loader spikes correlate with a recent model load (model: lm-open-7b-quant) on those nodes. memory climbs to >95% before OOM.

alice.nguyen: mitigation plan: 1) reduce traffic to apac-east, 2) pin model version on offending host, 3) restart pods, 4) monitor. applying routing override now.

alice.nguyen: command: `/infra route override set --cluster apac-east --weight 0.1 --reason "prober 502 spike"`
incident-bot: route override applied: apac-east weight -> 0.1 (was 1.0) by alice.nguyen

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook invoked: runtime-oom (initiated by alice.nguyen) — steps: pin model, restart pod pool, enable cache-eviction throttle. docs: https://runbooks.redwood.com/runtime-oom

samir.khan: pinning model on runtime-rt-12 to v1.2.3: `runtimectl model pin --node runtime-rt-12 --model lm-open-7b-quant --version v1.2.3`

maria.patel: restarting pod pool for runtime-rt-12 now. restarting 3 pods sequentially.

alice.nguyen: PD note: traffic reduced and restarts in progress. initial customer impact estimated low — some requests being routed to fallback region causing higher latency for a small subset.

customer-success-bot: flagged 2 customer sessions with elevated error rates in last 10m: acme-inc (session 4421), finmetrics (session 8819). opening tickets and notifying account owners.

samir.khan: after 2/3 restarts memory usage on runtime-rt-12 stabilized, OOM no longer observed in last 90s, 5xx count dropping.

alice.nguyen: still seeing a slow trickle of 502s but below alert threshold. keeping watch. i'll prepare handoff in 15m to @leo.chen.

alice.nguyen: handoff summary for next on-call: reduced apac traffic to 10%, pinned model v1.2.3 on runtime-rt-12, restarted 3 pods, reopened PD P23456 for monitoring, customers notified. followups: investigate model loader cache eviction policy and recent model auto-loads, verify memory caps on runtime node pool.

leo.chen: taking over. ack. any outstanding tasks I should run right away?

samir.khan: watchlist: pod restart logs, runtime memory and model-loader meter, 5xx rate. escalate to infra if 5xx > 5% sustained for 10m.

alice.nguyen: added notes & links to incident doc https://incidents.redwood.com/P23456 — leaving now.

leo.chen: will continue monitoring. if stable for 30m i'll close PD and lift routing override. keeping channel updated.

pd-bot: Incident P23456 status updated: acknowledged -> monitored -> on-call handoff to leo.chen

alice.nguyen: closing note: root cause appears to be an unintended model load causing memory pressure and OOMs on runtime-rt-12; mitigations applied (traffic reroute, model pin, pod restarts). no sustained customer outage identified, small subset saw elevated errors/latency. will follow up with a writeup in retro. :white_check_mark:
